prompt: Please create an **ultra-high-resolution, printable 3:4 vertical poster** based on the final input theme. The overall structure adopts a diptych layout with two areas, top and bottom, with the **top and bottom heights strictly 1:1, each occupying 50% of the frame**.  The **upper part** generates a complete, unified, realistic, and lived-in scene based on the theme. If the theme is a city, please first understand its core temperament, extract visual clues from spatial landscapes, street life, humanistic style, commercial atmosphere, dietary memories, local culture, historical layers, and daily rhythms, and naturally organize them into the same authentic and vivid urban slice, rather than a fragmented collage. If the theme is a specific street, neighborhood, landmark, business district, shop, building, or representative location, please focus on real spatial relationships, accurately presenting street structures, architectural interfaces, shop signs, transportation facilities, text systems, crowd states, and live atmosphere, while preserving its most recognizable local features. If the theme includes an address, coordinates, or reference pictures, please prioritize understanding the scene based on real information; do not fabricate out of thin air, do not randomly replace location features, and do not draw generic landscapes unrelated to the theme. Overall, avoid cheap tourism promotion and postcard-style expressions, but instead capture a restrained, exquisite, authentic theme moment with daily warmth; characters, buildings, streets, signs, windows, facilities, and activities coexist naturally, and landmarks merge into the environment without being exaggerated or overpowering.  The **lower part** extracts the **most recognizable subjects, outlines, structures, postures, and narrative relationships** from the upper scene and reconstructs them into a **minimalist linear graphic expression**. Do not mechanically trace details, but instead re-express with thin and accurate single lines, clear geometric perspective, restrained white space, orderly rhythmic details, and moderately abstract generalized forms, while retaining immediately recognizable thematic features. If the theme leans towards a city or location, the most critical architectural skyline, street interface, sign rhythm, transportation facilities, window relationships, or crowd states can be extracted; if the theme is not a city, its most core identity features, outline language, structural relationships, and visual memory points should also be extracted and transformed into a unified, concise, modern, and high-end line-drawing poster language. A small amount of geometric auxiliary elements, horizontal lines, vertical structural lines, or rhythmic white space can be added, making the lower part look like a refinement and redesign of the realistic scene in the upper part.  The **text system** needs to be naturally integrated into the overall layout, continuing this restrained, high-end, and modern poster logic. Set a striking main title at the top; the subtitle can use the original theme text, local language, country or region information, address, coordinates, number, year, or a short description. If the screen contains street text, signs, or location information, it must be clear, natural, authentic, and professional, avoiding garbled codes, wrong text, and random spelling. The text layout should be simple and orderly, and together with the picture, it should form a degree of completion like a collector-grade travel poster and city brand visual, rather than an explanatory label casually pasted on later.  Colors should not mechanically follow fixed templates, but should first understand the climate, light, sense of time, building materials, historical atmosphere, commercial warmth, dietary impression, natural environment, and emotional texture of the theme itself, and then extract the relationship between the **primary color and background color exclusive to the theme**. The overall style can adopt monochrome printing aesthetics or a very small amount of restrained color matching, forming rich changes through line density, brightness levels, local weighting, white space ratios, and detail rhythms, avoiding monotony and flat tiling. The final product should present a poster effect with **clear lines, rich details, unified style, quiet and modern, agile and restrained, and high aesthetic quality**.

promptZh: 请根据最终输入的主题，创作一张 **超高分辨率、可打印的 3:4 竖版海报**。整体结构采用双联画布局，分为上、下两个区域，**上、下高度严格保持 1:1，各占画面 50%**。**上方区域**根据主题生成一个完整、统一、写实且具有生活气息的场景。如果主题是城市，请先理解其核心气质，从空间景观、街头生活、人文风格、商业氛围、饮食记忆、在地文化、历史肌理和日常节奏中提取视觉线索，并将它们自然地组织成同一个真实而生动的城市切片，而非碎片化的拼贴。如果主题是特定的街道、社区、地标、商圈、店铺、建筑或代表性地点，请聚焦于真实的空间关系，准确呈现街道结构、建筑界面、店招、交通设施、文字系统、人群状态和现场氛围，同时保留其最具辨识度的在地特征。如果主题包含地址、坐标或参考图片，请优先基于真实信息理解场景；切勿凭空捏造，不要随意替换地点特征，也不要绘制与主题无关的通用景观。整体上，避免廉价的旅游宣传和明信片式的表达，而是捕捉一个克制、精致、真实的瞬间，展现日常的温度；人物、建筑、街道、招牌、窗户、设施和活动自然共存，地标融入环境之中，不夸张、不喧宾夺主。**下方区域**从上方场景中提取 **最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态和叙事关系**，并将其重构为 **极简的线性图形表达**。不要机械地描摹细节，而是用纤细且精准的单线、清晰的几何透视、克制的留白、有序的节奏细节和适度抽象的概括形式进行重新表达，同时保留一眼即识的主题特征。如果主题偏向城市或地点，可以提取最关键的建筑天际线、街道界面、招牌韵律、交通设施、窗户关系或人群状态；如果主题非城市，也应提取其最核心的身份特征、轮廓语言、结构关系和视觉记忆点，并将其转化为统一、简洁、现代且高端的线条海报语言。可以添加少量几何辅助元素、水平线、垂直结构线或节奏性留白，使下方看起来像是对上方写实场景的提炼与再设计。**文字系统**需要自然地融入整体布局，延续这种克制、高端且现代的海报逻辑。在顶部设置醒目的主标题；副标题可以使用原始主题文本、当地语言、国家或地区信息、地址、坐标、编号、年份或简短描述。如果画面包含街道文字、招牌或地点信息，必须清晰、自然、真实且专业，避免乱码、文字错误和随意拼凑。文字排版应简洁有序，与画面共同形成如收藏级旅行海报和城市品牌视觉般的完成度，而非随意贴上去的说明标签。色彩不应机械地遵循固定模板，而应首先理解主题本身的气候、光影、时间感、建筑材料、历史氛围、商业温度、饮食印象、自然环境和情感质感，进而提取出 **该主题专属的主色与背景色关系**。整体风格可采用单色印刷美学或极少量克制的配色，通过线条密度、明暗层次、局部加权、留白比例和细节韵律形成丰富的变化，避免单调和平铺。最终成品应呈现出 **线条清晰、细节丰富、风格统一、静谧现代、灵动克制且具有高审美品质** 的海报效果。
